literalCallbackAudit.callbackText: test('4665/1933实际击败才自身狂暴，没击败不授与自身免异阻挡消费',()=>{const s=turn(make(e(1933),{targetHp:1}));assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,0);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].ailments['狂暴']);assert.equal(turn(make(e(1933))).fighters[0].ailments['狂暴'],undefined);const im=make(e(1933),{targetHp:1});im.fighters[0].counts.immune=1;turn(im);assert.equal(im.fighters[0].ailments['狂暴'],undefined);assert.equal(im.fighters[0].counts.immune,0);})

literalCallbackAudit.name: 4665基础37484 破灭天启剑实际HP/PP/控制未用/末次与零PP
literalCallbackAudit.callbackText: test("4665基础37484 破灭天启剑实际HP/PP/控制未用/末次与零PP",()=>{const z=turn(make({moveId:37484,index:-1}));assert.equal(z.fighters[0].pp[key(37484)],4);assert.equal(sum(z)>0,true);const b=make({moveId:37484,index:-1});b.fighters[0].ailments['疲惫']=3;turn(b);assert.equal(b.fighters[0].pp[key(37484)],5);const p=make({moveId:37484,index:-1});p.fighters[0].pp[key(37484)]=0;assert.throws(()=>turn(p),/PP|技能/);p.fighters[0].pp[key(37484)]=1;turn(p);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].pp[key(37484)],0);})

literalCallbackAudit.name: 4665/1718后手基础50且敌HP更高额外50，先手不触发并保留真实红伤
literalCallbackAudit.callbackText: test('4665/1718后手基础50且敌HP更高额外50，先手不触发并保留真实红伤',()=>{for(const [spe,hp,multiple]of[[500,8000,1],[30,9000,1.5],[30,8000,2]]){const s=turn(make(e(1718),{aStats:{spe},hp})),base=turn(make(e(1718),{aStats:{spe},hp,omit:true}));assert.ok(sum(s)>0);assert.ok(Math.abs(sum(s)-sum(base)*multiple)<=2);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,9000-sum(s));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(s.auditMoveId)],4);}})

literalCallbackAudit.name: 4665/1589异常时随机两不同真实PP归0，无异常与PP保护不减少
literalCallbackAudit.callbackText: test('4665/1589异常时随机两不同真实PP归0，无异常与PP保护不减少',()=>{const s=make(e(1589));s.fighters[1].ailments['沉默']=3;turn(s);assert.equal(Object.values(s.fighters[1].pp).filter(x=>x===0).length,2);const no=turn(make(e(1589)));assert.equal(Object.values(no.fighters[1].pp).filter(x=>x===0).length,0);const im=make(e(1589));im.fighters[1].ailments['沉默']=3;timer(im,1,'PP保护');turn(im);assert.equal(Object.values(im.fighters[1].pp).filter(x=>x===0).length,0);})

literalCallbackAudit.name: 4665/1304下两回合忽略30%真实双防红伤提高，首轮不生效与到期
literalCallbackAudit.callbackText: test('4665/1304下两回合忽略30%真实双防红伤提高，首轮不生效与到期',()=>{const s=turn(make(e(1304))),normal=make(e(1304),{omit:true});turn(normal);turn(s,10535);turn(normal,10535);assert.ok(sum(s)>sum(normal));turn(s,10535);turn(normal,10535);assert.ok(sum(s)>sum(normal));turn(s,10535);turn(normal,10535);assert.equal(sum(s),sum(normal));})
